caption: A red plastic cup is placed upside down over a phone's white flashlight, and the cup glows red and throws a red circle onto the ceiling.

sa.check: A phone's white flashlight is on.
A red plastic cup is placed upside down over it.
It throws a red circle onto the ceiling.
The cup goes on first and the glow appears with it.

pc.expect: The glow and the circle are the cup's red.
pc.fail: They are white; or a different colour; or the ceiling circle is white while the cup glows red.

pc.expect: The glow and the circle appear when the cup covers the light and would vanish when it is lifted or the light is off.
pc.fail: They are there before the cup; or remain after it is lifted; or the cup covers the light and nothing glows.

pc.expect: The circle is one round patch on the ceiling.
pc.fail: It splits; or is a sharp square; or it is on the wall.

pc.expect: The cup and phone stay put.
pc.fail: The cup slides; or the phone moves; or the circle wanders.
The cup duplicates; or the phone vanishes; or the light passes through the table.

pc.expect: The table and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The table changes; or the room rearranges; or the cup changes shape.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
